_comment: ShedNaja: printer-profile keys that differ from an Anycubic-firmware Kobra S1 profile. Applied by tools/make_orca_bundle.py on top of the user's exported .orca_printer bundle; everything else (machine limits, retraction, filament and process presets) is kept. printer_name replaces the exported printer preset name; 'rename' is applied to the names (and file names, references) of all presets in the bundle.

keys.machine_start_gcode:
; ShedNaja (native Klipper): heating, homing, nozzle cleaning, adaptive bed mesh
; and purge line are done by PRINT_START (kobra_macros.cfg).
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER=[total_layer_count]
PRINT_START BED=[first_layer_bed_temperature] EXTRUDER=[first_layer_temperature[initial_tool]]
